timestamp.description: Simulation time stamp in ISO 8601 format.

step.description: Simulation step represented by the diagnostic row.
step.name: step

scenario.description: Internal scenario number for the simulation.
scenario.name: scenario

simuuid.description: Unique simulation UUID assigned to the run.

plantNumber.description: Plant identifier associated with the diagnostic row.
plantNumber.name: plantNumber

fieldInstanceId.description: Field-instance identifier associated with the diagnostic row.
fieldInstanceId.name: fieldInstanceId

day.description: Legacy simulation day value retained from the carbon-transport diagnostic.
day.name: day

hour.description: Legacy simulation hour value retained from the carbon-transport diagnostic.
hour.name: hour

useCPStyleCTResponse.description: Whether the carbon-potential response formulation was used.

iterationCount.description: Number of iterations completed by the carbon-transport solve.
iterationCount.name: iterationCount

convergenceError.description: Final summed absolute carbon-flux convergence error.
convergenceError.name: convergenceError

totalLoading.description: Absolute sum of solved source-loading fluxes for the plant.
totalLoading.name: totalLoading

totalUnloading.description: Sum of solved sink-unloading fluxes for the plant.
totalUnloading.name: totalUnloading

netFluxResidual.description: Total loading minus total unloading for the solved plant.
netFluxResidual.name: netFluxResidual

relativeFluxResidual.description: Absolute net-flux residual relative to the larger loading or unloading magnitude.
relativeFluxResidual.name: relativeFluxResidual

minCp.description: Minimum organ carbon potential in the solved plant.
minCp.name: minCp

maxCp.description: Maximum organ carbon potential in the solved plant.
maxCp.name: maxCp

meanCp.description: Mean organ carbon potential in the solved plant.
meanCp.name: meanCp

minSugar.description: Sugar concentration transformed from the minimum organ carbon potential.
minSugar.name: minSugar

maxSugar.description: Sugar concentration transformed from the maximum organ carbon potential.
maxSugar.name: maxSugar

meanSugar.description: Sugar concentration transformed from the mean organ carbon potential.
meanSugar.name: meanSugar

ctPlantBaseFallbackUsed.description: Whether the current PlantBase boundary retained a previous potential or used the numerical floor.
ctPlantBaseFallbackUsed.name: ctPlantBaseFallbackUsed

ctPlantBaseFallbackReason.description: PlantBase boundary outcome code: 0 accepted root; 1 non-finite coefficient; 2 zero or near-zero denominator; 3 invalid candidate; 4 invalid transformed sugar.
ctPlantBaseFallbackReason.name: ctPlantBaseFallbackReason

ctPlantBaseFallbackCount.description: Cumulative number of guarded PlantBase boundary fallbacks for the plant.
ctPlantBaseFallbackCount.name: ctPlantBaseFallbackCount

ctPlantBaseResidual.description: Folded boundary residual A + B Phi at the accepted or retained PlantBase potential.
ctPlantBaseResidual.name: ctPlantBaseResidual

ctPlantBaseDenominator.description: Folded PlantBase B coefficient used to assess and solve the zero-net-flow boundary.
ctPlantBaseDenominator.name: ctPlantBaseDenominator

absoluteFluxError.description: Final sum of absolute organ-flux changes used by the mixed convergence test.
absoluteFluxError.name: absoluteFluxError

relativeFluxConvergenceError.description: Absolute flux-change error divided by the larger old or new total absolute flux.
relativeFluxConvergenceError.name: relativeFluxConvergenceError

ctPlantBaseAbsoluteResidual.description: Absolute folded PlantBase boundary residual after under-relaxation.
ctPlantBaseAbsoluteResidual.name: ctPlantBaseAbsoluteResidual

ctPlantBaseRelativeResidual.description: Absolute PlantBase residual relative to the local folded-boundary flux scale.
ctPlantBaseRelativeResidual.name: ctPlantBaseRelativeResidual

ctDampingFactor.description: Under-relaxation factor used for the final accepted PlantBase potential.
ctDampingFactor.name: ctDampingFactor

ctRawPlantBasePhi.description: Guarded raw PlantBase potential candidate before under-relaxation.
ctRawPlantBasePhi.name: ctRawPlantBasePhi

ctConverged.description: Whether the existing mixed flux-change and PlantBase boundary criteria passed without invalid simple-root topology or traversal.

ctMaxIterationReached.description: Whether the solve stopped at the configured iteration limit without convergence.

ctNonlinearMerit.description: Maximum normalized mixed-tolerance error across flux change and the PlantBase boundary.
ctNonlinearMerit.name: ctNonlinearMerit

ctRetryUsed.description: Whether the normal 30-iteration solve failed and the single retry was used.

ctRetryConverged.description: Whether the single retry converged and its state was accepted.

ctSolverFallbackUsed.description: Whether both attempts failed and the accepted pre-hour transport state was restored.

ctInvalidUnfoldTrialCount.description: Total invalid raw or accepted organ Phi trials across the normal solve and retry.
ctInvalidUnfoldTrialCount.name: ctInvalidUnfoldTrialCount

ctFinalIterationLimit.description: Iteration limit of the final solver attempt (30 normal or 60 retry).
ctFinalIterationLimit.name: ctFinalIterationLimit

ctBootstrapFallbackUsed.description: Whether initialization was restored provisionally because no converged hourly CT state existed.

ctHasAcceptedHourlyState.description: Whether at least one genuinely converged hourly CT solution has been committed.

ctStoredPlantBaseSugar.description: PlantBase phloem sugar stored after convergence or rollback.
ctStoredPlantBaseSugar.name: ctStoredPlantBaseSugar

ctPlantBaseSugarFromPhi.description: PlantBase phloem sugar transformed directly from the post-solve or restored cpt potential.
ctPlantBaseSugarFromPhi.name: ctPlantBaseSugarFromPhi

ctAcceptedHourlyPlantBaseSugar.description: PlantBase sugar of the committed/restored converged hourly state; zero when no such state exists.
ctAcceptedHourlyPlantBaseSugar.name: ctAcceptedHourlyPlantBaseSugar

ctFailedTrialPlantBasePhi.description: PlantBase potential of the final complete finite nonlinear trial before rollback.
ctFailedTrialPlantBasePhi.name: ctFailedTrialPlantBasePhi

ctFailedTrialPlantBaseSugar.description: PlantBase sugar transformed from the final complete finite nonlinear trial before rollback.
ctFailedTrialPlantBaseSugar.name: ctFailedTrialPlantBaseSugar

ctFailedTrialMinSugar.description: Minimum organ sugar in the final complete finite nonlinear trial before rollback.
ctFailedTrialMinSugar.name: ctFailedTrialMinSugar

ctFailedTrialMaxSugar.description: Maximum organ sugar in the final complete finite nonlinear trial before rollback.
ctFailedTrialMaxSugar.name: ctFailedTrialMaxSugar

ctFailedTrialMeanSugar.description: Mean organ sugar in the final complete finite nonlinear trial before rollback.
ctFailedTrialMeanSugar.name: ctFailedTrialMeanSugar

ctFailedTrialMerit.description: Mixed nonlinear merit of the final complete finite nonlinear trial before rollback.
ctFailedTrialMerit.name: ctFailedTrialMerit

sumLocalJ.description: Signed sum of all solved local GrowingOrgan carbon currents.
sumLocalJ.name: sumLocalJ

pbFoldedJ.description: Folded PlantBase current A plus B Phi for the final nonlinear pass.
pbFoldedJ.name: pbFoldedJ

closureResidual.description: Signed graph-closure residual sumLocalJ minus pbFoldedJ.
closureResidual.name: closureResidual

closureScale.description: Graph-closure scale: maximum of total absolute local current, absolute PlantBase current, and numerical epsilon.
closureScale.name: closureScale

relativeClosureResidual.description: Absolute graph-closure residual divided by closureScale.
relativeClosureResidual.name: relativeClosureResidual

closureNormalizedError.description: Graph-closure error normalized by the active mixed CT tolerances.
closureNormalizedError.name: closureNormalizedError

netFluxIdentityResidual.description: Numerical check netFluxResidual plus sumLocalJ; zero confirms loading/unloading sign categorization.
netFluxIdentityResidual.name: netFluxIdentityResidual

totalGrowingOrganCount.description: Number of transport-participating GrowingOrgan objects in the plant scope.
totalGrowingOrganCount.name: totalGrowingOrganCount

foldedGrowingOrganCount.description: Number of GrowingOrgan objects contributing to exactly one fold owner in the final pass.
foldedGrowingOrganCount.name: foldedGrowingOrganCount

unfoldedGrowingOrganCount.description: Number of GrowingOrgan objects receiving Phi from exactly one unfold owner in the final pass.
unfoldedGrowingOrganCount.name: unfoldedGrowingOrganCount

foldCoverageComplete.description: Whether every scoped GrowingOrgan contributed through exactly one fold owner.

unfoldCoverageComplete.description: Whether every scoped GrowingOrgan received Phi from exactly one unfold owner.

sumLeafJ.description: Signed sum of stored final Leaf currents.
sumLeafJ.name: sumLeafJ

sumLeafTaylorJ.description: Signed sum of Leaf local Taylor values A plus B Phi.
sumLeafTaylorJ.name: sumLeafTaylorJ

sumPetioleJ.description: Signed sum of stored final Petiole currents.
sumPetioleJ.name: sumPetioleJ

sumPetioleTaylorJ.description: Signed sum of Petiole local Taylor values A plus B Phi.
sumPetioleTaylorJ.name: sumPetioleTaylorJ

sumShootJ.description: Signed sum of stored final Internode, Cordon, and Trunk currents.
sumShootJ.name: sumShootJ

sumShootTaylorJ.description: Signed sum of shoot-axis local Taylor values A plus B Phi.
sumShootTaylorJ.name: sumShootTaylorJ

sumFruitJ.description: Signed sum of stored final FruitService currents.
sumFruitJ.name: sumFruitJ

sumFruitTaylorJ.description: Signed sum of fruit local Taylor values A plus B Phi.
sumFruitTaylorJ.name: sumFruitTaylorJ

sumFlowerJ.description: Signed sum of stored final Flower currents.
sumFlowerJ.name: sumFlowerJ

sumFlowerTaylorJ.description: Signed sum of Flower local Taylor values A plus B Phi.
sumFlowerTaylorJ.name: sumFlowerTaylorJ

sumFineRootJ.description: Signed sum of stored final FineRoot currents.
sumFineRootJ.name: sumFineRootJ

sumFineRootTaylorJ.description: Signed sum of FineRoot local Taylor values A plus B Phi.
sumFineRootTaylorJ.name: sumFineRootTaylorJ

sumStructuralRootJ.description: Signed sum of stored final StructuralRoot currents.
sumStructuralRootJ.name: sumStructuralRootJ

sumStructuralRootTaylorJ.description: Signed sum of StructuralRoot local Taylor values A plus B Phi.
sumStructuralRootTaylorJ.name: sumStructuralRootTaylorJ

sumFruitExactUnloading.description: Signed sum of non-mutating exact fruit active unloading plus direct mass flow at final local Phi.
sumFruitExactUnloading.name: sumFruitExactUnloading

sumFruitExactActive.description: Signed sum of non-mutating exact active fruit unloading at final local Phi.
sumFruitExactActive.name: sumFruitExactActive

sumFruitExactMassFlow.description: Signed sum of non-mutating exact direct fruit mass flow at final local Phi.
sumFruitExactMassFlow.name: sumFruitExactMassFlow

sumFruitStoredUnloading.description: Signed sum of fruit unloading bookkeeping values observed in the final nonlinear pass before accepted carbon-status commit.
sumFruitStoredUnloading.name: sumFruitStoredUnloading

fruitLinearizationRelativeResidual.description: Absolute aggregate fruit linearization residual relative to solved or exact fruit import magnitude.
fruitLinearizationRelativeResidual.name: fruitLinearizationRelativeResidual

maxFruitLinearizationResidual.description: Largest absolute per-fruit solved-current versus exact-unloading residual.
maxFruitLinearizationResidual.name: maxFruitLinearizationResidual

maxFruitLinearizationRelativeResidual.description: Largest relative per-fruit solved-current versus exact-unloading residual.
maxFruitLinearizationRelativeResidual.name: maxFruitLinearizationRelativeResidual

maxFruitResidualOrganID.description: Graph node identifier of the fruit with the largest absolute local consistency residual.
maxFruitResidualOrganID.name: maxFruitResidualOrganID

maxFruitTaylorPointResidual.description: Largest absolute pure Taylor reconstruction residual when re-expanded at final fruit Phi.
maxFruitTaylorPointResidual.name: maxFruitTaylorPointResidual

maxFruitTaylorPointRelativeResidual.description: Largest relative pure Taylor reconstruction residual when re-expanded at final fruit Phi.
maxFruitTaylorPointRelativeResidual.name: maxFruitTaylorPointRelativeResidual

simpleRootActive.description: Whether this solve used the deterministic simple layered root CT route.

simpleRootTopologyValid.description: Whether simple roots and fine roots form one complete linked layer chain for the plant.

simpleRootFoldValid.description: Whether every simple-root layer folded once with complete structural-root and fine-root coverage.

simpleRootUnfoldValid.description: Whether every simple-root layer and fine root received potential exactly once.

simpleRootDoubleFoldCount.description: Number of attempted second StructuralRoot resistance transforms in the same simple-root fold pass.
simpleRootDoubleFoldCount.name: simpleRootDoubleFoldCount

simpleRootMinLayer.description: Minimum soil-layer index in the simple-root chain.
simpleRootMinLayer.name: simpleRootMinLayer

simpleRootMaxLayer.description: Maximum soil-layer index in the simple-root chain.
simpleRootMaxLayer.name: simpleRootMaxLayer

simpleRootLayerCount.description: Number of contiguous layers expected in the simple-root chain.
simpleRootLayerCount.name: simpleRootLayerCount

simpleStructuralRootExpected.description: Number of StructuralRoot objects expected in the simple-root fold and unfold.
simpleStructuralRootExpected.name: simpleStructuralRootExpected

simpleStructuralRootFolded.description: Number of simple StructuralRoot objects transformed exactly once in the final fold pass.
simpleStructuralRootFolded.name: simpleStructuralRootFolded

simpleStructuralRootUnfolded.description: Number of simple StructuralRoot objects unfolded exactly once in the final pass.
simpleStructuralRootUnfolded.name: simpleStructuralRootUnfolded

simpleFineRootExpected.description: Number of FineRoot objects expected to contribute to the simple-root fold and unfold.
simpleFineRootExpected.name: simpleFineRootExpected

simpleFineRootFolded.description: Number of same-layer FineRoot objects actually included once in the final simple-root fold pass.
simpleFineRootFolded.name: simpleFineRootFolded

simpleFineRootUnfolded.description: Number of same-layer FineRoot objects unfolded exactly once in the final pass.
simpleFineRootUnfolded.name: simpleFineRootUnfolded

simpleRootLocalJ.description: Signed sum of local StructuralRoot and FineRoot currents in the simple-root subsystem.
simpleRootLocalJ.name: simpleRootLocalJ

simpleRootFoldedJ.description: Current entering the simple-root subsystem through folded layer zero at PlantBase potential.
simpleRootFoldedJ.name: simpleRootFoldedJ

simpleRootClosureResidual.description: Signed simple-root closure residual: local root current minus folded root-entry current.
simpleRootClosureResidual.name: simpleRootClosureResidual

simpleRootRelativeClosureResidual.description: Absolute simple-root closure residual relative to the larger local or folded root current magnitude.
simpleRootRelativeClosureResidual.name: simpleRootRelativeClosureResidual
